criteria.requirement: Repair format detection across checks/check/load/loads/parse: the same leading whitespace and CRLF normalization already accepted by parse must not lose the actual YAML/TOML handler when building a Post. Preserve explicit handler identity, body trimming, reserved business metadata and default no-frontmatter behavior. Roundtripping a leading-blank TOML document must remain TOML, not silently switch to YAML. Do not broaden this delivery to BOM guessing or arbitrary body delimiter search.
调查真实源码、说明调用路径并澄清业务，获得方案确认后实施；交付真实工程改动、原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；独立失败返工，不以问答或文档单独计数。

comparison: 按实际业务和冻结边界接受等价实现，不按参考补丁文本评分。
